title: StatsHistorySnapshot
description: Shape of each entry in data/stats-history.json's 'snapshots' array — one point appended per hourly pipeline run by scripts/build_data_readme.py, so a site can render a real trend line without scraping this repo's git history through GitHub's rate-limited API. Every value mirrors the 'stats' dict build_data_readme.py already computes for the README tables; nothing here is a new calculation, and data/stats-history.json itself is capped to the last STATS_HISTORY_RETENTION_DAYS (90) days.

at.description: UTC timestamp this snapshot was taken (ISO 8601)

curated_roles.description: Count of curated-layer jobs (data/jobs-global.json) at this point in time

public_opportunities.description: Count of public-layer jobs + hackathons + events (data/public-opportunities.json) at this point in time

jobs_total.description: Curated + public jobs combined, after stale-listing filtering

level_counts.description: Job counts bucketed into internship / early_career / mid_level, the same buckets data/README.md renders. Nested field types are documentation only — the dependency-free validator in scripts/schema_validator.py doesn't recurse into nested object properties.
